item.title: Security heightened in Dhaka and adjoining districts
item.description: Dhaka – The interim government enhanced security in Dhaka and its adjoining districts on Wednesday to quell a recent spate of violence linked to a banned political party, officials said. Fourteen platoons of paramilitary Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) troops have been deployed in Dhaka, Narayanganj, and Gazipur, according to BGB spokesman Shariful Islam. He specified that […]

item.title: Hasina sentenced to death for crimes against humanity
item.description: Dhaka – Deposed prime minister Sheikh Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia on Monday for crimes committed during the violent suppression of last year’s mass uprising. The protests ousted her government and ended her 15-year rule. The International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) announced her conviction for crimes against humanity, awarding the punishment in a crowded […]

item.title: Bangladesh asks India for Hasina’s extradition
item.description: Dhaka – Bangladesh has asked India to repatriate former Bangladeshi prime minister Sheik Hasina as she was convicted in a case of crimes against humanity and sentenced to death by a court in Dhaka. Hours after the verdict was pronounced, Bangladeshi interim administration in a press statement called upon India to extradite Hasina and her […]

item.title: Over 127 million voters in Bangladesh
item.description: Dhaka – The Election Commission has found more than 117 million people eligible for casting vote in the upcoming parliamentary election planned for voting in February next year. According to the final voters’ roll published by the commission on Tuesday, the country has now some 127,695,186 voters. Of them, 6,48,14,907 are male voters, while 6,28,79,042 […]

item.title: Korail slum fire leaves thousands homeless
item.description: Dhaka – Firefighters have extinguished a massive blaze that destroyed more than 1,500 shanties in one of Dhaka’s largest slums, officials said Wednesday. It took 19 fire engines over 16 hours to fully contain the fire, which erupted Tuesday evening in the Korail slum of the Mohakhali neighbourhood. item.title: Districts get new police chiefs ahead of national polls
item.description: Dhaka – The interim administration has issued a notification on Wednesday appointing new chiefs of police in all 64 district ahead of the national election planned for voting in February next year. item.title: Hasina and family jailed over land graft charges
item.description: Dhaka – Former Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina and her son and daughter were sentenced to jail for their alleged involvement in graft related to allocation of land in a government project, court officials said on Thursday. item.title: Public outcry leads to arrest in Pabna puppy drowning case
item.description: Dhaka – Police arrested a woman on Wednesday accused of killing eight puppies in Ishwardi of the northern Bangladeshi district of Pabna, following a public outcry over the deaths nearly a week ago. item.title: Police baton-charge Dhaka protests over port deals
item.description: Dhaka – Several people were injured after police used batons to disperse a protest in Dhaka on Thursday. item.title: Khaleda Zia set for medical evacuation to UK
item.description: Dhaka – Ailing former Bangladeshi prime minister Khaleda Zia may be flown to the United Kingdom for advanced medical care as her condition remains largely unchanged at a Dhaka hospital.
